PC: Initial assessment of patient, ask for vital signs.
Recognize respiratory decompensation after 1st epi dose, repeat IM epinephrine every 5-15 minutes as needed.
Administer adjunct anaphylaxis medications: steroids, diphenhydramine, ranitidine, albuterol.
MK: Recognize tachycardia, tachypnea, respiratory distress, hives.
SBP: Call medics (911) immediately upon recognizing decompensating patient.
